spellbook.finance/limitations: It reads only jobs the signed-in person started. Another account's jobId answers forbidden, and an unknown or expired jobId answers not_found.
planning, pending, uploading, processing and ingesting mean the job is still running and no card is confirmed live. Say the job is still running.
complete means every card reached an end state, and partial means at least one card failed. Neither state alone means a card is live, so read each items row.
already_listed means eBay refused the card as a duplicate of a listing the seller already has. The card is live under that older listing, and this job carries no id for it.
A live row with no ebayItemId came from a job that ran before listing ids were stored. missingFields then names items[].ebayItemId, and the listing id is in the seller's eBay Seller Hub.

When itemsTruncated is true, cards past the inline cap carry no per-card state here, and missingFields names items. When failuresTruncated is true, failures holds only the most recent rows and failureCount holds the total.
jobType ebay_bulk_reprice marks a price change to listings that already exist. A reprice job never creates a listing.
It reads status only. It cannot retry, cancel or unstick a job. After a failure, fix the named cause and preview the matching publish or reprice tool again.

description: Read one eBay bulk job by the jobId returned from spellbook_ebay_publish or spellbook_ebay_reprice. Both operations queue work, so call this before telling the person a listing was created or its ask changed. State planning, pending, uploading, processing or ingesting means the job is still running: call again after about a minute. State failed carries errorMessage, and each failures row carries a per-card reason: relay that reason to the person. Returns state, counts, per-card items, failures and missingFields.

jobId.description: The jobId returned by spellbook_ebay_publish or spellbook_ebay_reprice. Required.
